== Description ==
Today, I want to show you a short gameplay of the truck event. I am part of HC nh and am rushing trucks for the global leaderboard. I am at 175 truck orders rn and plan to complete 200-225 by the end of the day. Tomorrow I am streaming at 6pm (ET) and would be happy to see you! :)

► DON’T FORGET TO WRITE IN THE COMMENTS "What do you think about the global truck orders event?"
